title: The retro's zero-invocation skill flag counts only tool == Skill rows, blind to other delivery channels
summary: Taught compute_zero_invocation_skill_flags() about tag_registry.py::get_skill_mapping()'s tag-driven routing: a covered skill is reported separately (channel named) instead of flagged; corrects 3 real misflagged skills (api-design-principles, debugging-strategies, python-performance-optimization) on the live corpus.
